neighboring_unit_entries.title: Below the first node, zero is the optimal minorant and a squared quotient is the majorant
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Interlacing rules out interior quadrature nodes, while Laguerre-Polya monotonicity makes a normalized quotient dominate the interval; quadrature then certifies both extrema.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: A de Branges representation turns continuous weighted optimization into interpolation at orthogonal kernel nodes; endpoint position selects the node family, and subtracting the two interval extremizers recovers the two-point extremizer.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: The theorem requires properties P1-P4 and changes construction across root, generic, and below-first-root regimes.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: The one-delta optimum is governed by reciprocal diagonal kernel mass, while the two-delta optimum adds the magnitude of the off-diagonal kernel interaction; interval-bound width realizes the latter quantity.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: The hierarchy concerns nonnegative entire functions of the fixed exponential type and weighted norm, not arbitrary zero-spacing statistics.
